summary:
{
  "ledger": [
    "Concrete banks and ramps | Sloped bank lies left of the skater, with low ramps and ledges farther behind | Banks recede behind the moving camera as the adjacent bowl fills the view | Their changing projections are compatible with continuous low-angle tracking and camera roll.",
    "Bowl and dark coping | Curved bowl boundary becomes visible left of the skater during the first jump | Near coping curves across the foreground and up the right edge, with the bowl interior behind it | Tracking progressively reveals the lower basin; the skater crosses above the lip and descends into the visible interior without a wrong-side emergence.",
    "Round concrete pedestal | Fixed on the flat pavement to the skater’s right at the opening | Outside the frame after the camera advances | Moves toward the right frame edge before leaving view; no contradictory reappearance.",
    "Rectangular ledges and pole-side ramp | Low ledges stand beyond the skating route, including a raised area around a prominent light pole | Pass toward the right and out of the close view | Relative placement of ledge, ramp, and pole remains compatible with camera translation.",
    "Light poles | Tall poles distributed around the ramps and perimeter behind the skater | Several remain visible beyond the bowl | Apparent leaning changes with the wide-angle camera and roll; the skater and board correctly occlude pole segments when overlapping.",
    "Trees, grass strip, and small shelter | Trees line the distant perimeter, with grass and a small dark shelter beyond the concrete | Remain beyond the bowl and ramps | Background shifts continuously with viewpoint; nearer concrete and the skater occlude the distant elements consistently.",
    "Skater and skateboard | Foreground moving subjects between the camera and park structures | Descend into the bowl beyond the foreground coping | Across both jumps their silhouettes occlude distant ramps, trees, and poles; no fixed background surface visibly renders over them or reveals them through an opaque obstruction."
  ],
  "findings": []
}
